premise: Raccoon counts; Ladybug hides under Mushroom's cap, but Bear cub is too big to hide anywhere, so he closes his eyes — if he can't see them… — falls asleep, and his snore gives him away.
inspiration: The folk hide-and-seek game where the biggest can't hide, turned: being found is the fun, and the sleepiest player wins the best nap.
lesson: Being found is part of the fun.

en-US.title: Bear Cub Plays Hide-and-Seek
en-US.text: {raccoon:enter} Raccoon had a game. [excited] "Hide-and-seek! I'll count!" {raccoon:live peekaboo hold} He covered his eyes. "One… two… three…" Quick as a wink, {ladybug:enter} Ladybug spotted {mushroom:enter} Mushroom and {ladybug:go under mushroom} crept under her red cap. {mushroom:face happy} [giggles] "That tickles!" But {bear:enter} Bear cub was far too big to hide. {bear:face sad} Not behind Mushroom. Not behind a rock. {bear:sparkle} Then he had an idea. "If I close my eyes, nobody can see me!" {bear:live nap hold} So he closed his eyes… and nodded off. {sfx:snore} Zzz… zzz… "…eight, nine, TEN!" {raccoon:live peekaboo resume} "Ready or not, here I come!" {raccoon:face happy} Raccoon {raccoon:live listen} listened hard. Zzz… zzz… {raccoon:go to bear} [laughs] "Found you!" {bear:live nap resume} Bear cub woke with a start. {bear:face surprised} "How did you know?" he asked. "You were snoring!" said Raccoon. {mushroom:live sneeze} Mushroom giggled so hard that… ah… ah… {sfx:achoo} ACHOO! {ladybug:go back} Out crawled Ladybug. {all:face happy} {all:hop} "Found you too!" Now it was Bear cub's turn to count. "One… two…" {bear:live nap hold} "three…" [whispers] Zzz. {ladybug:hearts} So everyone hid, and Bear cub had the best nap in the meadow.

es-ES.title: Osito juega al escondite
es-ES.text: {raccoon:enter} Mapache propuso un juego. [excited] —¡Al escondite! ¡Me la quedo yo! {raccoon:live peekaboo hold} Se tapó los ojos. —Uno… dos… tres… Rapidísima, {ladybug:enter} Mariquita vio a {mushroom:enter} Seta y {ladybug:go under mushroom} se coló bajo su sombrero rojo. {mushroom:face happy} [giggles] —¡Ay, qué cosquillas! Pero {bear:enter} Osito era demasiado grande para esconderse. {bear:face sad} Detrás de Seta no cabía. Detrás de una piedra, tampoco. {bear:sparkle} Entonces se le ocurrió una idea: —¡Si cierro los ojos, nadie me verá! {bear:live nap hold} Cerró los ojos… y se quedó frito. {sfx:snore} Zzz… zzz… —…¡ocho, nueve y DIEZ! {raccoon:live peekaboo resume} ¡Allá voy! {raccoon:face happy} Mapache {raccoon:live listen} aguzó el oído. Zzz… zzz… {raccoon:go to bear} [laughs] —¡Te pillé! {bear:live nap resume} Osito se despertó de un respingo. {bear:face surprised} —¿Cómo lo has sabido? —preguntó. —¡Porque roncabas! —se rió Mapache. {mushroom:live sneeze} A Seta le dio tanta risa que… aaa… aaa… {sfx:achoo} ¡ACHÍS! {ladybug:go back} Y salió Mariquita, gateando. {all:face happy} {all:hop} —¡A ti también te pillé! Ahora le tocaba contar a Osito. —Uno… dos… {bear:live nap hold} tres… [whispers] Zzz. {ladybug:hearts} Así que todos se escondieron, y Osito se echó la mejor siesta del prado.

snore.prompt: a bear cub snoring softly and slowly, cute and cosy

achoo.prompt: a tiny, cute comic sneeze, achoo, with a soft sparkly twinkle after it, playful
